Application Data.NAME: Stitch & Craft Boutique
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitch & Craft Boutique is a fabric and sewing store specializing in a wide range of sewing supplies, fabrics, and crafting materials. Our operations include retail sales of high-quality fabrics, sewing patterns, and essential tools for enthusiasts and professionals alike. We also offer workshops led by certified instructors, focusing on various sewing techniques and project executions, ensuring a safe learning environment. Our premises are equipped with comprehensive safety measures, including fire prevention protocols, regular maintenance of equipment, and secure alarm and surveillance systems. Additionally, we conduct ongoing employee training for safe handling of materials and equipment, and all participants sign updated liability waivers before attending workshops.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a sewing machine malfunction resulted in a fire, causing property damage estimated at $10,000. The incident was promptly reported, and repairs were completed by 04/30/2022. The business implemented additional safety protocols and scheduled regular maintenance checks on all equipment following the event. On 01/10/2023, a minor slip-and-fall incident occurred in the store, leading to a claim of $5,000, which was settled and resolved by 02/15/2023. Both incidents have been utilized to reinforce employee training and safety measures.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures are in place including a monitored alarm system, 24/7 video surveillance, and regular inspections by security personnel. Additionally, we have a secure fenced area for high-value materials and a dedicated watchperson during operational hours to ensure safety and deter theft.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Preferred:
– Businesses with no prior claim history, demonstrating a strong commitment to risk man-
agement through comprehensive safety protocols, including fire prevention measures and
regular equipment maintenance.
– Stores that conduct regular employee training focused on safe handling of fabrics, sewing
machines, and chemicals (such as dyes or adhesives), as well as secure premises with
adequate alarm and surveillance systems to deter theft and vandalism.
– Operations that limit customer classes to small groups with certified instructors and
maintain up-to-date liability waivers.
• Acceptable:
– Businesses with minor or infrequent claims, such as small property damage or slip-and-
fall incidents, provided corrective measures have been implemented.
– Stores offering occasional sewing machine repair or maintenance services, assuming tech-
nicians are properly trained and safety protocols are documented.
